evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.meaning: Dark Sphere (Q) costs 40/45/50/55/60 mana by rank.
Force of Will (W) costs 60/70/80/90/100 mana by rank; 100 at rank 5.
Scatter the Weak (E) costs a flat 50 mana at every rank.
Unleashed Power (R) costs a flat 100 mana at all three ranks.
Transcendent is the only Syndra slot with no resource cost; it is a passive, not a cast.

sources_quoted.quote: Collecting a Splinter of Wrath from an enemy restores 20 : 255 (based on level) mana.
sources_quoted.meaning: Syndra's only zero/negative mana interaction is a RESTORE, not a zero-cost cast; it does not make any cast free.

sources_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
sources_quoted.meaning: The synthetic Q2 (2nd charge) slot is still a Dark Sphere cast: a stocked charge bypasses the cooldown, and no cached text grants it a mana exemption. Its cost is Q's cost (40-60), not 0 and not 100.

sources_quoted.quote: Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target towards the target location ... | The initial cast does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade ...
sources_quoted.meaning: W is grab + recast-throw. Mana is paid once, on the initial grab; the recast is free. This is the ONLY construction under which a 0.0 entry could be legitimate, and it requires the timeline entry to be a W recast rather than a fresh cast.
The castable slot set is Q, Q2, W, E, R (P is a buff). Every castable slot has a strictly positive sourced mana cost.

sources_quoted.quote: splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage
sources_quoted.meaning: Reading of the scenario name: 'syndra_custom_order_60' most plausibly = custom cast order with splinters=60 (the W bonus-true-damage threshold). Splinters change damage riders, never mana costs.

sources_quoted.quote: src/calculator/damage.py computes a rotation from a DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R) ... the fight's cast_order ... {order: [Q,E,E,E,...], rationale: ...}
sources_quoted.meaning: cast_timeline entries are one-per-slot-cast derived from a cast order; a 'custom_order' scenario supplies a non-default order of SLOT CASTS. Each such entry is a real ability activation and therefore pays mana.
math-foundations carries no resource-cost formula; the cached wiki cost table is the sole authority for this leaf.

step_1_enumerate_sourced_costs.Q2 (stocked Dark Sphere charge): same as Q at Q's rank (40-60); no cached exemption exists

independent_computation.step_2_admissible_values: The set of admissible resource_cost values for a Syndra ABILITY CAST is {40,45,50,55,60,70,80,90,100}. 0.0 is not a member of that set at any rank of any ability.
independent_computation.step_3_match_the_old_value: 100.0 is an exact member of the sourced table and is reachable two ways: R at every rank (100/100/100), or W at rank 5 (100). Both are ordinary states for a maxed-out Syndra scenario, so the old value is a correctly-sourced cost, not a stale literal.
independent_computation.step_4_can_0_be_reached: 0.0 is reachable only for a non-cast: (a) the P passive slot (cost null), or (b) a W recast/throw, or (c) a secondary R sphere in a multi-sphere barrage - mana is paid once on the initial activation. All three require cast_timeline[1] to be something other than a fresh ability activation. The field is a CAST timeline in a scenario whose distinguishing feature is a custom order of slot casts, so each index should map to one activation.
independent_computation.step_5_mana_pool_sanity: Syndra mana = 480 + 40 x (L-1) x (0.7025 + 0.0175 x (L-1)) -> 1160.0 at L18, 1266.6 at L20. A full Q(60)+W(100)+E(50)+R(100) = 310 rotation is far inside the pool, so no mana-starvation rule could legitimately drive a cast's recorded cost to 0; an unaffordable cast would be dropped from the timeline, not recorded at cost 0.
independent_computation.conclusion: The correct value is a strictly positive sourced mana cost - 100.0 if cast_timeline[1] is R (any rank) or W at rank 5, which is exactly what the old baseline recorded. 0.0 corresponds to no Syndra ability cast at any rank and is the signature of a cost lookup that silently defaulted (the failure mode CLAUDE.md rule 5 exists to prevent).

residual_uncertainty.note: Per the runbook I could not read the scenario definition (tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/ are off-limits), so the slot identity of cast_timeline[1] is inferred, not observed.
residual_uncertainty.verdict_would_flip_to_new_value_correct_: cast_timeline[1] is provably NOT a fresh activation - i.e. it is the W recast/throw, a secondary R sphere of the same barrage, or a P/buff-phase entry inserted into the timeline. In that case mana is paid on the preceding entry and 0.0 is right.
residual_uncertainty.verdict_would_be_both_wrong_if: cast_timeline[1] is a Q/Q2 (40-60) or E (50) cast, in which case the old 100.0 was also wrong.
residual_uncertainty.confidence: moderate-to-high that 0.0 is wrong (no Syndra cast costs 0); moderate that 100.0 is the exact right number (it is an exact sourced value and the field name plus the scenario's custom-cast-order framing both point at a genuine activation).
